shared_elements: relief carving with figures in a bounded field
justification: Both depict human figures in profile who hold or present objects, and both use relief with some patterned decorative elements, but these are generic to figural relief traditions. A shows a uniform single-file procession of near-identical robed, bearded men with bowls against an empty ground, while B is a dense, horror-vacui composition organised around a central tree with elaborately costumed, masked figures flanking it and enclosed by ornamental scroll and stepped borders — the conventions of proportion, crowding and framing are entirely different.
